title: Asking the Way
label: ch:ta-asking-the-way
canDo: I can ask the way with … eppaṭip pōka vēṇṭum? and eṅkē irukkiṟatu?, ask how far it is, and give directions with nērākap pōṅkaḷ, tirumpuṅkaḷ and landmarks such as kōyilukku etirē.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 288: ask the way and how far it is, and give the way back with polite requests and landmarks.
